externalSources.supports: Los Roques as a national park in the Venezuelan Caribbean with beaches, coral cays, shallow lagoons, maritime tourist activities.
Lake Titicaca is a high-altitude inland lake in Bolivia and Peru with boat and cultural visits, not an ocean beach resort.
Uyuni is a high-altitude salt flat whose shallow-water mirror effect is not beach recreation.
